purpose: Prospectively declared component controls reconstructed after loss of unverified auxiliary artifacts
different_contract_comparison: Report payload-only differences separately because altered graphs have different manifest and capability-contract byte costs; no speedup or retention guarantee relative to the original contract is claimed
no_alternative_producers_rule: Keep the first captured replayable producer of each physical output and mark every later producer of that physical output unavailable while preserving all provenance nodes
logical_identity_rule: Assign each distinct captured logical node its own selectable identity and charge its actual captured size without changing dependencies; metadata-only counterfactual and not fresh replay
archive_deduplication_control: Sum the sizes of captured logical node outputs versus unique captured physical outputs; this is full-archive output accounting and is not a no-deduplication retention solver

certificate_controls.compare: Indexed worklist certificate and independent fixed-point scan on identical chains

execution_order: Rotate seven controls by repetition to disclose order effects; timings are descriptive single-host measurements rather than isolated performance claims
input_rule: Use immutable seed101 capture manifests from the complete recovered matrix and freeze source and input hashes in run_start.json; fail on any missing declared history rather than shrinking the matrix
exclusions: No exclusion by outcome; timeouts and changed-contract controls remain visible
